symptom: A quoted `Editable: '$currentObject/Locked = false'` on a checkbox or text box passes check and exec ("Created page") and is stored `Editable: Always` with no ConditionalEditabilitySettings, so a field meant to be locked stays editable; `describe page` prints the widget without any Editable. The quoted `Visible: '<expr>'` beside it is stored as a conditional visibility, and the unquoted `Editable: $currentObject/Locked = false` works. `Editable: false` on an input was dropped the same way
cause: `applyConditionalSettings` (cmd_pages_builder_v3.go) consulted only `pages.CanonicalEditability`, which accepts exactly Always|Never|Conditional and answers ("", false) for any other string, so the `else if` did not fire and the default Always stayed. `Visible` goes through `pages.StaticVisibleExpression`, whose default branch hands any other non-empty string back as the expression. MDL-WIDGET19 let every bool/string through for both keys ("a static form StaticVisibleExpression consumes"), true for Visible and false for Editable; a bool never reached the builder at all because it read the value with GetStringProp, which is "" for a bool
insight: Two sibling properties with the same grammar slot but different consumers: one takes any string as an expression, the other only an enum word and skips the rest silently. A skipped write must be a refusal, so the fix is one rule for both keys (a string that is not the property's plain value is its condition) PLUS a check that names what still cannot be stored (a lone word such as `Neever`, text that is not an expression, `Conditional` with no condition). Every reader of `EditableIf` is a second consumer of the same value and has to see the quoted spelling too: MDL-WIDGET13 (association step, CE0117), MDL-BUTTON02 (own container name), MDL-WIDGET41 (pluggable Editability gate) and MDL-WIDGET20; fixing only the builder leaves them blind. Not every widget stores the enum: a list view and a grid column have a plain `Editable bool` (ako/mxcli#510), so a boolean there must NOT be read as Never/Always (`plainEditableWidgetTypes`). A quoted string reaches the validators unparsed, so a malformed quoted condition needs `visitor.ParsesAsExpression`; the bare spelling fails in the grammar. Quoted Visible still gets none of those checks (WIDGET13, BUTTON02, a syntax check) — left as is, same family. ALTER PAGE `set (Editable: '<expr>')` keeps its loud refusal (pagemutator setWidgetEditableMut); accepting it is about five lines (settings element plus the Conditional enum), not one. Control: same script on the pre-fix binary stores Always/null for the quoted widgets; the fix stores Conditional + expression, byte-equal (ids stripped) to the unquoted spelling, and describe -> exec reports `Unchanged page`. Side find, not fixed: a data view stores its static editability from its own ReadOnly flag (Forms$DataView.Editability), which the builder never sets from `Editable:`, so `DATAVIEW (Editable: Never)` is still stored Always (measured: bson dump shows Editability Always for Never, false and true alike); only the condition (ConditionalEditabilitySettings) is carried, and the quoted spelling now matches the bare one there
